semantic_rules: owner and peer identities are exact distinct Accounts and Devices
legacy HTTPS mode requires one normalized HTTPS service descriptor
exact volunteer mode forbids a service descriptor and requires a replica set on activation
mailbox address public keys must be derived from the carried read and write Ed25519 seeds
binding ID commits to the complete canonical core including mode, address and optional legacy service
HPKE AAD is the exact canonical envelope header and HPKE info is purpose-specific
peer offer is signed by owner Device then HPKE sealed to the exact recipient Device
replica store keys are distinct and strictly unsigned-bytewise ordered
generation one has no predecessor and later generations require the exact previous update ID
rotation changes binding ID, revocation targets the active predecessor and time never regresses
recipient acknowledgement commits to the authenticated session and every identity and generation field of the update

source_compatibility.normalization: both source versions translate to one explicit mode-tagged canonical family

requires: Postcard v1 and v2 translation tests
